name: Namma Metro Phase 3
scope: 44.65 km, 31 stations, two corridors: JP Nagar 4th Phase–Kempapura (Orange Line, Outer Ring Road west, 28.486 km double-decker viaduct) and Hosahalli–Kadabagere (Grey Line, Magadi Road, 8.635 km double-decker viaduct)
pending: Civil work tenders for the double-decker viaduct design delayed. Land acquisition, utility shifting and tree clearance still pending — of 6,72,117 sqm required, BMRCL has yet to take full possession, per Deccan Herald.
notes: original_deadline is inferred ("a year later than originally planned" relative to the confirmed 2031-05-01 current deadline) and not independently confirmed against a primary schedule document.
